correctness.rationale: The Weyl operators give an orthonormal matrix basis and diagonalize the full rank-one projector orbit Gram with eigenvalues D|A(h,eta)|². For the graph z=x·y, the support intersection after shift (a,b,c) is the hyperplane a·y+b·x=c-a·b. Additive character orthogonality reduces all w≠0 coefficients to a single q-term quadratic sum with coefficient a·b and linear coefficient wd+u·a+v·b. Its magnitude is q or 0 over characteristic two (trace makes s² linear), but sqrt(q) for odd field with a·b≠0. Separating w=0, graph zero pair, a·b=0 and a·b≠0 yields B=q^(2r-1)+(q-1)q^(r-1), the exact odd four-band and even three-band eigenvalue multiplicities and nullities, plus asymptotic rank fraction. The proof respects q prime powers, r≥2, projectors of unit-normalized indicator and unweighted Hilbert-Schmidt normalization. It makes NO universal pure-state phase retrieval claim.
